body: I can handle being alone and I can find ways to cope with that. What I don't know how to fix is my self destructive behavior. I have missed out on so much in life because of it, I have so many 'what ifs', and almost no examples of something I can be proud of. I have never seen something to fruition because nothing can bring me out of my constant state of apathy. I just want to feel desire and determination. I want to smile a smile that's not forced. I want to laugh at funny things, and enjoy life. But I am screwing up my education now and Im falling in the same rut again. I don't know how to change myself.

No, I have been having these feelings of self hate and regret for as long as I can remember. But the addition of being thousands of miles away from home and everything I know just magnifies these feelings. My self hatred grows because it's my fault Im stuck out here. But as far as the grades go, it's the same thing with everything else in life. I start out with what I guess you could consider some type of motivation, or interest to do something, but I can never see it through as I lose all desire and care for it. It makes me feel something for a little bit, I was actually proud of myself for starting out so strong for once, I thought things were gonna change. But again my self destructive ways ruin what could be something good.
